findings.criterion: the three researched numbers (DC-only, 8.6+, off-by-default; retry-after + up to 20% jitter) are each either confirmed against the target DC version or explicitly marked unverified
findings.detail: The code uses all three numbers as stated facts but does not explicitly confirm them against the target DC version nor explicitly mark any of them as 'unverified'. retry.py:32-37 attributes the 20% jitter to 'Atlassian's guidance' (a sourced claim, but not an explicit confirmation against a specific DC version). retry.py:177 and the test file docstring (line 3) state '8.6+, DC only, OFF BY DEFAULT' as plain facts with no 'confirmed' or 'unverified' label. The AC requires each number to be either confirmed against the target DC version or explicitly marked unverified; neither condition is satisfied in the codebase for the DC-only/8.6+/off-by-default trio.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
